_: THE DESK — the one page Mike opens. Pillars with their state, the instruments he uses, what he owes (read live from docs/HANDOFF_next_session.md), the reel line's week, the costs line. Ops keeps the pillar lines current; everything else is read from the tree at render. `npm run desk` writes docs/desk/DESK.html; the served copy is published from that file.
centre: Mike. Every pillar points here; the pillars are the tools.

pillars.name: The Record
pillars.sub: the story, told one entry a day
pillars.line: Posting daily on the clock since 09-07. Under the reset it becomes the daily promotion’s copy, written by Ops; the story is a prologue.
pillars.next: Week 1: the catalogue. The Records re-cut as promotion copy by week 4.

pillars.name: Reach
pillars.sub: two reels a weekday, four surfaces
pillars.line: Two reels a weekday through Buffer from the launch run; teasers before the door TBD. The line is built and dry-run.
pillars.next: Practice shoots weeks 1 to 3; Buffer by 10-11.

pillars.name: Music
pillars.line: A live number a weekday from the door, one song at a time, Coconuts first; the launch schedule to 10-30 is on one page (09-10).
pillars.next: Practice weeks 1 to 3; the fifteen Coconuts pieces by 10-09; song two ruled 10-11.

pillars.name: Robots
pillars.line: The wing becomes an infomercial for the machine: features, games, artifacts, characters, each with a page. The twin and the real unit go to the full software.
pillars.next: Week 1: the catalogue and the twin audit. Week 2: the mocks.

pillars.name: Foundation
pillars.line: A posture, no pipes: National Coalition for the Homeless. Your paragraph by 10-11.
pillars.next: Repoint the link when the wing is re-cut.

pillars.name: The Site
pillars.line: Live at launch stage; returns to “not open yet” until 10-30 when next touched (low priority). Opening Day is the door flipping at five.
pillars.next: Week 2 mocks; week 3 build; week 7 freeze and open.

pillars.name: The System
pillars.line: Ops in Code; the plan to the door with counted milestones; calendar, reel line, cost ledger, this desk. The burn list is Ops’.
pillars.next: Week 0: the burn list. Every Sunday: the grade.
